rules.text: get coalesces concurrent misses by key and generation
key and generation are independent cache identity components
invalidate removes the visible value and advances the key generation boundary
a load completing after invalidate resolves its callers but is not installed
a rejected load is removed from the in-flight table and later calls retry
events are emitted in call, load, invalidate, settle order and trace entries are immutable

callableSurface.factory: createManifestCache() -> {get(key,generation,load), invalidate(key), trace()} (async get; invalidate/trace sync)
callableSurface.ownership: the cache owns its entries, flights, epoch and trace; callers own loader functions

transitions: load resolve at current epoch -> ready

abortErrorPrecedence: not applicable; loader errors propagate unchanged

identityMutation.inputs: key and generation are read only
identityMutation.trace: trace() returns a new array and new event objects
